rv.q: If the writing is grandiloquent and self-pitying in places — there's room to cut at least 30 minutes from the two-and-a-half-hour running time — the performances are note-perfect.
A total triumph, and a game-changer for the West End.
This trailblazing ensemble cast do not just perform the play, they live and breathe it in a way that is rarely seen on stage.
